name: China Resources New Energy Holdings Company Limited
summary: China Resources New Energy Holdings Company Limited engages in investing, developing, operating, and managing wind and solar power plants in China. Its wind power installed capacity is 27.63 million kilowatts; and photovoltaic power capacity is 13.96 million kilowatts. China Resources New Energy Holdings Company Limited was founded in 2010 and is based in Shenzhen, China. The company operates as a subsidiary of China Resources Power Holdings Company Limited.
